title: Kennedy Center Board Votes to Restore Trump's Name, Close Building for 2-Year, $250M Renovation
detail: The Kennedy Center's Trump-appointed board of trustees voted on August 13, 2026 to add the inscription 'Restored and Renovated by President Donald J. Trump' beneath the venue's main signage and to designate the surrounding grounds 'President Donald J. Trump Plaza,' about three months after a federal judge ordered Trump's name removed from the building, ruling only Congress could authorize such a change. The board also approved closing the main building until 2028 for a $250 million infrastructure renewal project — the most extreme of three closure options presented. Democratic board member Rep. Joyce Beatty called the move 'a transparent effort to circumvent the Court's ruling'; the decision is expected to trigger further litigation.

media.caption: Kennedy Center board votes to restore Trump's name to the venue and close it for two years

title: Judge Sullivan Presses DOJ, Raises Contempt Threat Over Epstein Files Redactions
detail: US District Judge Emmet Sullivan held a hearing on August 13, 2026 pressing Justice Department attorneys on whether the Trump administration had complied with his prior orders in the Epstein files case, including a requirement to publish justifications for numerous redactions. Sullivan warned he has held lawyers in contempt before and said resisting further release could be detrimental to the attorneys' careers. The judge also raised concern that DOJ withheld handwritten notes from an interview with a woman who made unsubstantiated allegations against President Trump, who denies wrongdoing. In June, Sullivan found the redactions and withheld materials violated the Epstein Files Transparency Act.

media.caption: Judge Emmet Sullivan presses DOJ attorneys over Epstein files redactions, raises contempt threat
